validation_status: Unvalidated approximation profile. Numerical contract tests do not establish agreement with published HyLIoS, measured skin, or physiological correctness.
scope: Spectral coverage only; raw extinction/absorbance/reference-sample bases retained. No concentration, molar-mass, ln(10), tissue-mixture or Table IV scaling beyond the strict importer conversions.
strict_reference_policy: Unchanged: no tails or substitutions in strict source import. This profile must be selected explicitly.
limitations: Zero tails are explicit omissions, not measured transparency.
100 nm e-fold decay is an arbitrary empirical assumption, not a literature fit.
Scaled oxyhemoglobin substitutions do not preserve unmeasured dyshemoglobin features.
Lipid endpoint holds omit any unmeasured UV and >2449.5 nm bands.
Melanin tail exponents come from a visible-appearance model; extension to 2500 nm has not been validated.
Hale-Querry substitutions are interpolated source tables and empirical continuity splices.
Original irregular source gaps remain visible; interpolation across them supplies no new measurements.
Source files are not vendored; redistribution permission has not been established.
